spec.text: God is the one who discerns, knows or understands thoughts in Ps 139:2 ('you discern my thoughts'), Ps 94:11 and 1Cor 3:20 ('knows the thoughts'), Isa 66:18 ('I know their works and their thoughts') and 1Chr 28:9, where the Lord 'searches all hearts' and 'understands every plan and thought'. In Ps 139:23 God is asked to know the speaker's thoughts. Jesus is the one who perceives or knows their thoughts in Luke 5:22, 6:8 and 11:17 and in Matt 9:4 and 12:25. In Heb 4:12 the word of God discerns 'the thoughts and intentions' of the heart.

actions.new_text: What thoughts are: Design: forming something that does not yet exist. H2803G (19 rows) describes craftsmanship: cherubim "skillfully worked" (Exod 26:1, 31) and "skilled design" (Exod 39:3). The faculty itself is neutral. *Maḥăšāvāh* covers both artistry and plots, and *mᵊzimmāh* covers both "discretion" (Prov 2:11) and "evil devices" (Prov 12:2). What makes a thought good or evil is what it is designed toward.; Reckoning: giving something its value or category. H2803H/J (60 rows): Human misreckoning: Eli "took her to be a drunken woman" (1 Sam 1:13), "we esteemed him stricken" and "we esteemed him not" (Isa 53:3–4), Judah "thought she was a prostitute" (Gen 38:15).; God's reckoning: "he counted it to him as righteousness" (Gen 15:6), "the Lord counts no iniquity" (Ps 32:2), and the nations "accounted as the dust on the scales" (Isa 40:15, 17).; To think is to judge the worth of something, and people can judge wrongly.; Inner speech.; "all his thoughts are, 'There is no God'" (Ps 10:4). The thought is quoted as a sentence.; Hannah "was speaking in her heart; only her lips moved" (1 Sam 1:13).; *Dialogismos* covers both inner reasoning and outward "argument", "quarreling" and "disputing".; "conflicting thoughts accuse or even excuse" (Rom 2:15).; Something that affects the body and emotions.; "his thoughts alarmed him; his limbs gave way, and his knees knocked together" (Dan 5:6; also 4:19; 5:10; 7:28).; "the cares of my heart" (Ps 94:19), and "haste within me" (Job 20:2).; A divided mind stalls a person: "limping between two different opinions" (1 Kgs 18:21, H5587A).; Creaturely and passing.; "but a breath" (Ps 94:11).; "When his breath departs … on that very day his plans perish" (Ps 146:4).; "futile" (1 Cor 3:20; Rom 1:21).; "striving of heart … striving after wind" (Eccl 2:22; 4:16).
actions.checked: the last claim ('fully open to God') is the meaning of #12431 and the evidence 22669; its text and nodes are taken out; the remaining claims are unchanged
actions.reason: the observation held six findings; the sixth is carried
